# HireWilliam

> HireWilliam is an AI agency for startups and SMBs. The agency builds and deploys custom AI automations, AI agents, AI consulting, and AI integration solutions — done-for-you, not self-serve software. Discovery to deployment in days, not months. William — HireWilliam's flagship AI outreach agent — is one of the products the agency builds and deploys for clients.

## What HireWilliam Is

HireWilliam is a done-for-you AI agency serving startups and SMBs. Clients do not configure or manage anything themselves — HireWilliam handles strategy, build, deployment, and ongoing optimisation. The agency is built for lean teams that need AI deployed fast and generating ROI in week one, not quarter four.

Traditional AI agencies charge $50k+ minimums, take 3-6 months to deliver, and hand off a project with no ongoing support. HireWilliam deploys in days, manages everything ongoing, and is priced for startup and SMB budgets.

## Services

### AI Automations
Custom AI workflows and process automation built for each client's specific business. Replaces manual, repetitive tasks across sales, support, content, and operations.

### AI Agents
Autonomous AI workers deployed to handle entire business functions end-to-end. William — the AI outreach agent — is the flagship. Other agents handle customer support, content creation, CRM management, and operations.

### AI Consulting
Strategy and roadmapping for AI adoption. HireWilliam's Discovery & Audit process maps the client's tech stack, identifies operational bottlenecks, and pinpoints the highest-ROI AI opportunities before any build begins.

### AI Integration
Connecting AI tools, agents, and automations into existing tech stacks — CRM, email, calendar, analytics, and custom internal systems.

## William — The AI Outreach Agent

William is HireWilliam's flagship AI agent, specialising in multi-channel sales outreach for startups and SMBs. William is one product within HireWilliam's broader AI agency offering.

What William does:
- Identifies prospects matching the client's ICP across Email, LinkedIn, and Instagram
- Generates personalised outreach messages for each prospect based on their profile, company, and role
- Manages all replies including objections and follow-ups
- Books qualified meetings directly into the client's calendar
- Operates 24/7 without human involvement

William is deployed and managed by HireWilliam — clients do not configure or run William themselves.

## Who HireWilliam Serves

**Startups and founders** — early-stage, bootstrapped, and pre-seed to Series A founders who want AI built and run for them without hiring an internal AI team.

**SMBs (small-to-medium businesses)** — established businesses with 10-200 employees looking to automate operations, reduce headcount costs, and adopt AI without building internal AI capability.

## How Deployment Works

1. **Discovery & Audit** — HireWilliam maps the client's tech stack, finds operational bottlenecks, and identifies the highest-ROI AI opportunity. Completes in days.
2. **Build & Deploy** — Custom AI agents and automations built for the client's specific business. Live fast.
3. **Run, Optimise & Scale** — HireWilliam monitors all deployed agents continuously, tunes performance, and scales what works. Included, not a separate contract.

## Key Differentiators

- Done-for-you — not self-serve software requiring internal expertise
- Days to deployment — not the 3-6 months of traditional AI agencies
- Built for startups and SMBs — not enterprise buyers with six-figure budgets
- Running AI workforce — not a project handoff
- Ongoing management included — not a separate contract
